description: This file defines the 'OperationalCountry' entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_operational_country' database table and includes properties for 'id' and 'country', with Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: OperationalCountry
classes.description: Entity class representing an operational country record, with relations to the 'Country' entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the operational country.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the operational country.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a 'Country' entity with this operational country.
